neighbours.label: Anticipating a harmful or unwanted outcome: the word that sets up the damage to be avoided ('to prevent', 'could contaminate', 'risk of', 'can make you sick'); quiet on the same frames with a good outcome.
fire: Cover the pan with a lid to prevent the oil from splattering.
Wear gloves when handling raw chicken, since germs could spread to your hands.
Old wiring increases the risk of a fire in the kitchen.
Leaving milk out overnight can cause it to spoil.
Back up your files often, because a crash could wipe out months of work.
Wash the cut carefully to avoid an infection.
Driving on bald tyres can lead to a serious accident in the rain.
Keep the medicine locked away so that children cannot swallow it.
quiet: Cover the pan with a lid to let the rice cook evenly.
Wear gloves when gardening in spring, since the roses will bloom soon.
Fresh paint brightens the look of the kitchen.
Leaving dough out overnight can help it rise nicely.
Back up your files often, because your new laptop has plenty of space.
Wash the berries carefully to enjoy their full flavor.
Driving on new tyres can make the ride smoother and quieter.
Keep the photos in an album so that the children can enjoy them.
